author: Veritas I
title: Dilated CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention Pooling
abstract: This submission replaces the initial residual convolutional block with a Dilated Convolutional Block in the CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention architecture. The dilated CNN layers are designed to capture local sequence motifs at multiple scales, providing a richer feature representation for diverse RNA sequence lengths and characteristics. These multi-scale features are then processed by the BiLSTM and additive attention for enhanced and more robust overall performance across all seven RNA prediction tasks.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict, Tuple

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int # Hidden units for the attention scoring mechanism

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        
        # Compute attention scores
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)
        
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply attention weights to original sequence and sum
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1) # (batch, input_features)
        
        return pooled_output

# Dilated Convolutional Block
class DilatedConvBlock(nn.Module):
    conv_features: int
    kernel_size: int
    dilation_rates: Tuple[int, ...]
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic):
        # x_input shape: (batch, seq_len, input_features)
        
        # Apply a series of dilated convolutions
        for i, dilation in enumerate(self.dilation_rates):
            # Each conv has 'SAME' padding to preserve sequence length
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), 
                        padding='SAME', strides=(1,), # Ensure stride is 1
                        lax_window_dilation=(dilation,), # Apply dilation
                        name=f"dilated_conv_{i}")(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x

# Main network class
class DilatedCNNBiLSTMNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 192
    kernel_size: int = 9
    dilation_rates: Tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 4) # NEW
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 384
    attention_dense_units: int = 192
    dense_dim: int = 512
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # 1. Dilated CNN Block for local feature extraction
        x = DilatedConvBlock(
            conv_features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=self.kernel_size,
            dilation_rates=self.dilation_rates,
            dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Output shape: (batch, seq_len, conv_features)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 3. Additive Self-Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation
        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units)(x) # (batch, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 4. Dense Layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x) # (batch, dense_dim)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Dilated CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 192,
        'kernel_size': 9, 
        'dilation_rates': (1, 2, 4), # NEW
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 384,
        'attention_dense_units': 192,
        'dense_dim': 512,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_DilatedCNN:
    """Custom network wrapper for Dilated CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=192, kernel_size=9, dilation_rates=(1, 2, 4),
                 lstm_hidden_dim=384, attention_dense_units=192, dense_dim=512, dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = DilatedCNNBiLSTMNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            dilation_rates=dilation_rates,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
            dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 192)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    dilation_rates = hparams.get("dilation_rates", (1, 2, 4))
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 384)
    attention_dense_units = hparams.get("attention_dense_units", 192)
    dense_dim = hparams.get("dense_dim", 512)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_DilatedCNN(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        dilation_rates=dilation_rates,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
        dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )

# Debug Report for Evaluation 94

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed incorrect parameter name in Flax Conv layer. The code now runs without crashing.

## Root Cause
The original code used an incorrect parameter name `lax_window_dilation` when calling `nn.Conv()` in the `DilatedConvBlock` class (line 43 of original submission).

Flax's `nn.Conv` layer uses the parameter name `kernel_dilation` for applying dilation to convolutional kernels, not `lax_window_dilation`. This caused a TypeError during network initialization:

```
TypeError: Conv.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'lax_window_dilation'
```

## Fix Applied
Changed the parameter name from `lax_window_dilation` to `kernel_dilation` in the Conv layer call within the `DilatedConvBlock.__call__` method:

**Before (line 43):**
```python
x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME', strides=(1,),
            lax_window_dilation=(dilation,),  # INCORRECT
            name=f"dilated_conv_{i}")(x)
```

**After (line 48 in submission_v2.py):**
```python
x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME', strides=(1,),
            kernel_dilation=(dilation,),  # CORRECT
            name=f"dilated_conv_{i}")(x)
```

## Verification
The fixed code (submission_v2.py) was verified by the monitor script and has been running successfully for over 300 seconds without any crashes or errors. The network initialization and execution proceed correctly with the proper parameter name.

## Technical Details
- **Model Architecture:** Dilated CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention Pooling
- **Error Type:** Parameter naming error in Flax library usage
- **Fix Location:** `DilatedConvBlock.__call__` method, line 48 in submission_v2.py
- **Impact:** This was a critical bug preventing the network from being instantiated at all

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict, Tuple

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int # Hidden units for the attention scoring mechanism

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)

        # Compute attention scores
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)

        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply attention weights to original sequence and sum
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1) # (batch, input_features)

        return pooled_output

# Dilated Convolutional Block
class DilatedConvBlock(nn.Module):
    conv_features: int
    kernel_size: int
    dilation_rates: Tuple[int, ...]
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic):
        # x_input shape: (batch, seq_len, input_features)

        # Apply a series of dilated convolutions
        for i, dilation in enumerate(self.dilation_rates):
            # Each conv has 'SAME' padding to preserve sequence length
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
                        padding='SAME', strides=(1,), # Ensure stride is 1
                        kernel_dilation=(dilation,), # Apply dilation - FIXED: was lax_window_dilation
                        name=f"dilated_conv_{i}")(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x

# Main network class
class DilatedCNNBiLSTMNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 192
    kernel_size: int = 9
    dilation_rates: Tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 4) # NEW
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 384
    attention_dense_units: int = 192
    dense_dim: int = 512
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)

        # 1. Dilated CNN Block for local feature extraction
        x = DilatedConvBlock(
            conv_features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=self.kernel_size,
            dilation_rates=self.dilation_rates,
            dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Output shape: (batch, seq_len, conv_features)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)

        # 3. Additive Self-Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation
        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units)(x) # (batch, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)

        # 4. Dense Layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x) # (batch, dense_dim)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Dilated CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 192,
        'kernel_size': 9,
        'dilation_rates': (1, 2, 4), # NEW
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 384,
        'attention_dense_units': 192,
        'dense_dim': 512,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_DilatedCNN:
    """Custom network wrapper for Dilated CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=192, kernel_size=9, dilation_rates=(1, 2, 4),
                 lstm_hidden_dim=384, attention_dense_units=192, dense_dim=512, dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = DilatedCNNBiLSTMNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            dilation_rates=dilation_rates,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
            dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 192)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    dilation_rates = hparams.get("dilation_rates", (1, 2, 4))
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 384)
    attention_dense_units = hparams.get("attention_dense_units", 192)
    dense_dim = hparams.get("dense_dim", 512)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_DilatedCNN(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        dilation_rates=dilation_rates,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
        dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
